name: branch-compare
description: Two skills on git history. compare: before merging one branch into another (default staging into release), the commits the target is missing, cherry-picks, reverts, hotfixes to merge back, and what the merge would really change (trial merge): Kafka, migrations, config and required keys against each environment, dependencies, API, conflicts, sensitive code. changes: what changed between two tags, branches or commits of one or more services: business flows for BA/Test to accept, then for developers a copy-ready config block, commits, endpoints and Feign calls with breaking changes, Kafka, database schema, migrations and seeds, dependencies, links between services; one note per service in an Obsidian vault, then the vault's sync, one subagent per service. Read-only on the repositories.
